methodHandling.otherMethods: 405 {"error":"POST only"} - checked AFTER requireUser (unauthenticated GET gets 401)

auth.notes: When brandId is supplied the caller needs canEdit on it (owner, or admin for an org brand); otherwise 404 (not 403).

request.parse: content-type header must CONTAIN 'multipart/form-data' (case-sensitive substring) else 415 'Expected multipart/form-data'. `req.formData().catch(() => null)` -> parse failure 400 'Could not parse form data'.

fields.name: file
fields.validation: missing or a plain string field -> 400 'file is required'; empty or > 5 MiB -> 400 'Template must be a .pptx file up to 5 MB'; magic != 50 4B 03 04 -> 400 'File must be a valid .pptx' (any ZIP passes; filename/part content-type not checked)

fields.name: brandId
fields.validation: if non-empty string and caller lacks canEdit (unreachable, non-UUID, or read-only org member) -> 404 'Brand not found'. Checked BEFORE the file size/magic checks.

checkOrder: 9. write temp blob + pending job + trigger background

errors.when: brandId given but caller cannot edit it (incl. read-only org member)

body.error: Template must be a .pptx file up to 5 MB

sideEffects: Writes the upload to blob store 'brand-assets' at pptx-temp/<jobId>.pptx (blobs.ts:218-220); background deletes it in finally (brand-pptx-background.ts:322)
Writes job record {status:'pending', userId} to store 'brand-pptx-jobs' key pptx/<jobId>.json (blobs.ts:257-259)

POSTs {jobId, userId, pptxKey, brandId} to <origin>/.netlify/functions/brand-pptx-background with 3 attempts (0, +200ms, +600ms); failures are only logged, never surfaced - the 202 is returned and the job stays 'pending' forever (trigger.ts:3-25,75-81)

Background (brand-pptx-background.ts) then: re-checks edit access, calls PPTX_API_URL/brand-extract (multipart file + capture_all_layouts=true, bearer PPTX_API_TOKEN, 3 attempts with 8s/20s backoff on 5xx, 100s timeout each), and when brandId is set concurrently RENDER_API_URL/render-layouts?width=1600 (2 attempts), auto-extracts logo to brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/logo.png (converting non-PNG via sharp), stores furniture.json (+ furniture-all.json when layoutsByIndex present), layout-preview-<i>.png blobs, then writes the done/error job (brand-pptx-background.ts:161-326)
externalCalls: Slide Studio / SlideForge brand-extract (PPTX_API_URL, PPTX_API_TOKEN) and layout render API (RENDER_API_URL, default https://slideforge-api.whitewater-efc2081a.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io) - from the background function, not this handler. No paid LLM call.
quirks: Without brandId: no logo, furniture, headingPlaceholders or layoutPreviews are produced; only extracted fields come back.
Read-only org member supplying an org brandId gets 404, not 403 (docs/api.md:700 notes this).
Trigger failure is swallowed: client polls 'pending' indefinitely.
No daily cap or rate limit.
The extracted fields are NOT persisted to the brand kit; the client must PATCH /api/brands (only logo/furniture/preview blobs are written directly).
No dedicated unit test for this foreground handler (no _tests/brand-pptx.test.ts).

tests.asserts: background producer only; see api-brand-pptx-status.json tests (3 of 4 tests currently time out - stale mocks)

callers.expects: multipart file + optional brandId; non-ok -> body.error or 'Upload failed (<status>)'; ok -> {jobId}
multipart files={'file': ('template.pptx', bytes, pptx mime)}, data={'brandId'}; status <400 and resp.json()['jobId']

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1340-1375. Only the 202 is documented; 400/404/405/415 undocumented. brandId 'Must be a brand you own' - actually edit access (admin for org brands); unauthorised brandId -> 404.

planSection65: Row: 'POST multipart file, brandId -> 202 {jobId}'. Accurate. Note brandId is optional, 415 on non-multipart, 5 MiB limit, and 404 (not 403) for non-editable brands.
